title: Zesty Chewy Egyptian Garlic Stew
description: A garlicky and energizing Egyptian dish that's perfect for a Buddhist temple-friendly meal. The mixed spice and chewy texture will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Chop the onions, carrots, and potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Add the chopped vegetables to the pan and saut3 them until tender.
Grate the ginger and mix it with the mixed spice.
Add the garlic cloves to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef bouillon to the pan and stir to combine.
Roll out the kneaded dough into a thin sheet.
Place the dough sheet in the bamboo steamer vessel.
Steam the dough in the bamboo steamer for 10 minutes.
Add the green beans to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Zesty Chewy Egyptian Garlic Stew hot, garnished with chopped green beans.
Let the dish cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the steamed dough into serving portions.
Serve the steamed dough pieces on the side of the stew or blend into the stew for a fun twist.
